annotations.title: asksteps: switch an appointment type on or off (needs the account's mandate)

description: Switches an appointment type on (active = true, people can then book it) or off (active = false). Requires "automation:write". Both directions need the account's mandate "activate" and work in three steps: without it the answer is "confirmation_required" with the studio link and NOTHING happens — hand the user the url; with the mandate and without confirm the answer is "input_required" with the findings and what the switch does — read it to the user and ask; only with confirm = true it is carried out, and the account owner is emailed about it. Switching on needs bookable staff unless the assignment is "org" ("invalid" with "no_bookable_staff" otherwise — staff is assigned in the studio). Public booking is never changed by this tool.

active.description: true to switch on, false to switch off.

confirm.description: Set to true only AFTER the user has explicitly agreed. Without it nothing is switched.

name: asksteps_set_appointment_type_active

active.description: Whether the appointment type is switched on after the call.

issues.description: The findings that block (or would block) switching on, with path and code. "no_bookable_staff" means staff has to be assigned in the studio first.

path.description: Where the problem is, for example "parts[2].settings.templateId", "edges[0].condition" or "durationMinutes". Indices count in the list you sent.

shortcode.description: The shortcode at fault, when the problem is a shortcode. Empty otherwise.

missing.description: The parameters you still have to supply: ["confirm"] on "input_required".

note.description: One or two sentences for the user. On "input_required" it says what the switch does.

status.description: Outcome. One of: "activated", "deactivated", "unchanged" (already in that state), "input_required" (the mandate is there; read note and issues, ask the user and call again with confirm = true), "confirmation_required" (the account has not authorised an agent to do this: NOTHING happened, give the user the url), "invalid" (the checks failed, for example "no_bookable_staff"), "stale" (someone switched it meanwhile: NOTHING happened, read it again), "not_found", "rate_limited", "not_connected", "error". Authorisation can also refuse before the tool runs: "plan_required" (the account's plan does not include agent access), "not_enabled" (the account owner has not switched agent access on), "permission_denied" (the connected user's role lacks the permission; the note names it), "mandate_required" (the owner has not granted a mandate for this). The note then says what the user has to do.

typeId.description: The id of the appointment type.

url.description: Path of the editor in the asksteps studio, where the user does it themselves.

title: asksteps: switch an appointment type on or off (needs the account's mandate)
